scope: Hypothetical neutral-cap endpoint offsets, not installed anchors. Holds proximal origins and elbow axis fixed. Point and straight chord probes screen only both bones and central hinge hardware; they do not assess a curved muscle or installed connector. Quasi-static balance fixes the caps and neglects contact, preload and friction. Zero extensor stiffness is a lower-bound comparison.
